## Important epistemic rules

- INDEXED != PROVEN
- CHAIN COMPLETE != CLAIM PROVEN
- README-only verification is invalid
- NOT_PROVEN != DISPROVEN; S2-D is CLOSED - NOT_PROVEN
- WEB ACCESS != EXPERIMENT REPRODUCTION

## Access limitation

If you cannot access raw evidence or execute validators, report the limitation rather than inferring proof.
